verdict.rationale: Otter documents an Otter API & Webhooks tier plus native automations that push action items directly into project/ticketing tools like JIRA, Asana, ClickUp, Zendesk/ServiceNow, and via Zapier, matching the agent-access story of auto-filing action items into trackers. Missing for 10: explicit Linear integration evidence and independent/hands-on confirmation that these JIRA/Asana/webhook automations work reliably in practice.
